## Recent articles
- https://oler.pages.dev/blog/pyth-oracle-integration-with-bun-and-elysia — A practical look at Pyth price feeds, Hermes, and how to expose them through a small Bun + TypeScript + Elysia REST API.
- https://oler.pages.dev/blog/uniswap-ai-agents-and-the-next-interface-for-defi — A recent Uniswap AI SDK announcement hints at a bigger shift: DeFi workflows may increasingly be executed by agents instead of humans clicking through interfaces.
- https://oler.pages.dev/blog/how-to-deploy-a-static-nextjs-site-with-cloudflare-and-github-actions — A practical guide to shipping a static Next.js site on Cloudflare Pages with GitHub Actions, plus a safe way to store deployment secrets.
- https://oler.pages.dev/blog/forced-synchronous-communication-is-the-real-problem — Why some agile rituals create calendar pressure without improving coordination, and how teams can replace them with better async defaults.
- https://oler.pages.dev/blog/why-daily-standups-are-becoming-useless-in-the-ai-era — Daily standups used to be a coordination tool. Today, with better async workflows and AI-assisted status sharing, they often waste engineering time at scale.
- https://oler.pages.dev/blog/hono-with-bun-for-new-projects — A practical look at Hono and Bun: where the performance comes from, who maintains them, and why they make sense for greenfield projects.
- https://oler.pages.dev/blog/serena-mcp-for-claude-code — A short note on how to get more value from Serena when working with Claude Code, including the Claude-specific context and a practical fallback.
- https://oler.pages.dev/blog/elevenlabs-cli-agent-first-automation — Why removing interactivity as the default makes a CLI more predictable, automatable, and suitable for agent-driven workflows.

## Notes
- Blog posts are written in English.
- Content is Markdown-first and rendered statically at build time.
- Canonical URLs are preserved for republished articles.
- Sitemap, RSS, and social images are generated from the same source files.
